summary.text: Charity Krupa (listed by Ballotpedia as Charity Grimm Krupa) is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 51 who took office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Krupa graduated from Albert Gallatin High School in 1998, earned a B.A. in history from Penn State University in 2002, and received a J.D. from West Virginia University in 2005.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney.
Krupa succeeded Matthew Dowling in District 51.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Children & Youth, Human Services, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness committees.
